title: Desenvolvedor Java Senior - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades:

Java 17 ou superior: Experiência prática com recursos modernos da linguagem e foco em performance e legibilidade.

Apache Kafka com Confluent: Vivência com mensageria, criação de tópicos, configuração de produtores e consumidores.

FeignClient: Integração entre microsserviços via REST com uso de Feign.

Apache Camel: Conhecimento em rotas de integração e transformação de dados.

Testes Unitários e de Integração: Escrita de testes com JUnit e Mockito, com foco em qualidade e cobertura.

Gateways de API (Apigee ou CAAPI): Experiência na configuração de políticas de segurança, versionamento e controle de acesso.

Banco de Dados MySQL: Modelagem, consultas otimizadas e manutenção de dados relacionais.

Firebase: Uso de serviços como autenticação ou notificações em aplicações backend.

Design Hexagonal: Capacidade de aplicar o padrão de arquitetura para promover desacoplamento e testabilidade.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: SALES ASSISTANT (Inglês Fluente)
description:
Sales Assistant (Fluent English) | 100% Remote


At Blue Dot BPO, a Brazilian outsourcing company, we connect LATAM talent with top North American clients. Were looking for energetic, motivated professionals ready to grow their careers in international sales.


What We Offer

  • R$3,500/month
  • 100% remote direct contact with the U.S. market
  • Intensive, paid training in B2B sales
  • Long-term contract + real career growth opportunities
  • Monday to Friday, 1221h BRT (aligned with U.S. business hours)


What Youll Do

  • Support outbound prospecting campaigns (cold calls, emails, LinkedIn)
  • Assist in qualifying B2B leads and maintaining the sales pipeline
  • Support sales agendas, meetings, and materials
  • Collaborate on proposals and sales presentations
  • Conduct market research to identify trends and competitors
  • Use prospecting and CRM tools (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)


What Were Looking For

  • Fluent English (C1/C2) daily contact with U.S. clients
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Resilient, charismatic, and results-driven profile
  • Willingness to handle high volumes of outreach in a dynamic environment


Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM and prospecting tools
  • Previous experience in cold calling or outbound sales
  • Dynamic, charismatic, and fast learner
  • Consistent record of exceeding targets will be a plus


️ Tech Setup

  • 2 monitors | i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • Headset with microphone | High-speed internet
  • Quiet, interruption-free workspace


Work directly with the U.S. market, earn in reais and dollars, and take the next step in your international sales career!

️Apply now and be part of Blue Dot BPO:

title: Gerente Sênior de Engenharia (Setor Naval)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Gerente Sênior de Engenharia (Setor Naval). Este/a profissional atuará na elaboração e execução de projetos de engenharia para a construção de embarcações do tipo Offshore Support Vessel (PSVs, OSRVs e RSVs) numa parceria entre a Tenenge (marca pertencente a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção, especializada em projetos industriais) e o Estaleiro Enseada (complexo naval de projetos de construção, reparo e manutenção naval e offshore pertencente ao grupo Novonor) . Este/a profissional terá estas atribuições principais:


  • Liderar a equipe de engenharia na elaboração de projetos para a construção de embarcações tipo PSV, OSRV e RSV;
  • Garantir que todos os projetos sejam executados conforme o planejamento, dentro dos prazos e orçamento estabelecidos;
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos, seguindo as normas e regulamentos do setor naval;
  • Coordenar com outras áreas da empresa para garantir a integração e eficiência dos projetos;
  • Realizar análises técnicas e fornecer soluções inovadoras para desafios de engenharia;
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos técnicos e operacionais;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias do setor naval, aplicando melhores práticas nos projetos;
  • Gerenciar a comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos, incluindo clientes, fornecedores e parceiros internacionais.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência profissional no setor naval;
  • Desejável que este/a profissional possua experiência em projetos internacionais no setor naval;
  • Fortes habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipes;
  • Alta capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos e tomada decisões estratégicas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação;
  • Necessário possuir inglês fluente.



Sobre a Tenenge :


A Tenenge, marca pertencente a Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção, atua no segmento de Plantas Industriais de forma integrada, reunindo capacidade técnica, gerencial e financeira para executar o ciclo completo de empreendimentos de grande porte em regime de EPC e EPCM, em qualquer parte do mundo.

Com larga experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos de Construção e Montagem, cuja complexidade demanda alta especialização para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e segurança nos resultado, atua nos seguintes setores:


✔ Petróleo e Gás

✔ Naval

✔ Química e Petroquímica

✔ Termoeletricidade

✔ Bioenergia

✔ Siderurgia & Metalurgia

✔ Papel & Celulose



Sobre a Enseada:


A Enseada é um dos maiores investimentos privados da Bahia nos últimos anos, sendo o veículo que consolidou todo o conhecimento e expertise dos seus acionistas no segmento de construção naval e offshore. Com tecnologia Kawasaki Heavy Industries, a Enseada foi implantada estrategicamente às margens do Rio Paraguaçu, no Estado da Bahia. O estaleiro está localizado em águas abrigadas e com calado profundo, onde não há a incidência de correnteza ou ventos inesperados. Além disso, não há concorrência de atracação com outras indústrias como em outras regiões. Gerando emprego e renda para a região do recôncavo baiano, o local é reconhecido como celeiro de grandes projetos offshore desde a década de 1980.

title: SDR ESTAGIÁRIO
description:
ESTAGIÁRIO SDR - VOANDO COM GV AGÊNCIA DE VIAGENS


Pré-requisitos:


  • Estar matriculado(a) e frequentando regularmente uma instituição de ensino superior;
  • Morar em Uberlândia ou região;
  • Ser bom/boa comunicador(a);
  • Ter facilidade em conversar por ligação;
  • Ter escrita semântica e ortograficamente correta;
  • Digitar com rapidez.


Responsabilidades principais:


  • Qualificação: fazer o primeiro contato com leads/cliente via plataforma de mensagens gerando um diagnóstico sobre a qualificação de cada um para o departamento de Vendas;
  • Prospecção inbound: recontatar clientes da base para criar oportunidades de revenda ou prospectar indicações de leads com o perfil ideal;
  • Remarketing: recontatar leads reprovados para recuperar a atenção e refazer a qualificação.


Benefícios:


  • Bolsa-auxílio de R$ 800,00;
  • Trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar;
  • Bonificação por atingimento de metas;
  • Treinamentos pessoais e profissionais.


Tipo de contrato:


  • Estágio (Lei nº 11.788/2008);
  • Regime de trabalho Home Office;
  • Jornada de trabalho: segunda a sexta-feira, das 13h às 19h.


✨ É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da equipe da agência mais bem avaliada do Google no Triângulo Mineiro, que tem revolucionado a forma como as pessoas viajam na região e em todo o Brasil!
company: Voando com GV Agência de Viagens

title: Entry-Level Talent Sourcing (Hunter) - Remote
description:
Join Our Team as an Entry-Level Headhunter! No Experience Needed!


Oowlish partners with corporations and startups in the USA, Brazil, and Europe, helping these companies accelerate innovation by accessing the best talent in the industry. We thrive on innovation and offer a dynamic, supportive, and enjoyable workplace, operating without borders and making a difference worldwide. Our talented and engaged team fosters a culture of collaboration and inspiration, making Oowlish a 'Great Place to Work' .


The Entry-Level Headhunter does not need experience, should enjoy seeking out and interacting with new people frequently, and be able to determine if the candidates and the company are a good match, ensuring that their expectations are aligned.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and develop pipeline of eligible candidates for future open positions;
  • Collaborate with recruiters to identify appropriate experience and skillsets for desired positions;
  • Schedule introductory calls between the candidates and recruiters (fast track candidates);
  • Validate qualifications based on resume or profiles for candidates;
  • Send the online test to applicants based on the position that they applied for;
  • Create and re-new posts on different portals.


Must Have:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English;
  • Ability to balance priorities with a strong capacity to adapt to changing circumstances and dynamic environments;
  • Continuous learner.


Benefits & Perks:

  • Home office;
  • Flexible Hours (around 6 hours per day);
  • International Projects;
  • Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);
  • Oowlish fitness with Total Pass;
  • Connecting You (Internet allowance);
  • Pet adoption incentive;
  • Netflix Subscription;
  • Games and Competitions;
  • Enjoy your national Holidays;
  • Oowlet Store;
  • Agreement For Talent Acquisition Services: BRL 1.100,00 + Success fee per hire.


Come join us!

title: Social Sciences SME (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades

  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de CI/CD robustas e escaláveis, com foco em GitLab e ArgoCD .
  • Definir padrões e melhores práticas para Dockerfiles e gerenciamento de dependências.
  • Administrar e otimizar clusters OKE (Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes) em produção.
  • Liderar a automação de infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform .
  • Implementar estratégias completas de observabilidade , com Grafana, Dynatrace e Datadog .
  • Integrar ferramentas de segurança e qualidade de código, como Sonarqube e Veracode , ao ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir testes de performance com K6 e definir métricas de sucesso.
  • Liderar a implantação de soluções de autoscaling (Keda) e otimizações (Redwolf).
  • Mentorar a equipe, disseminando as melhores práticas de DevOps e SRE .


Requisitos

  • Experiência sênior como DevOps ou SRE .
  • Profundo conhecimento em CI/CD e automação de processos .
  • Expertise comprovada em GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD .
  • Experiência avançada em Kubernetes, OKE e Helm .
  • Domínio de Terraform para IaC.
  • Experiência na implementação e gestão de observabilidade (Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog).
  • Vivência com testes de performance (K6) .
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança de código (Sonarqube, Veracode).
  • Experiência prática com Keda e Redwolf .
  • Forte conhecimento em OCI e GCP .
  • Vivência em liderança técnica ou mentoring .


Atuação Remota em horário comercial.


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Especialista Power Platform (Apps & Automate)
description:
Sobre a empresa

A nocobi é uma empresa focada em automatização de processos dos nossos clientes através soluções utilizando ferramentas de Low e NoCode. Desde o nosso início, tivemos cerca de 70 clientes em mais de 20 países, e estamos longe de desacelerar!

Nossos projetos variam de pequenas a grandes soluções. Desenvolvemos Relatórios Power BI (fizemos um para mais de 1200 usuários), Aplicativos internos e soluções de automação via RPA e BPA.

Hoje trabalhamos quase que majoritariamente com clientes do exterior, dos mais variados, desde empresas de serviços, industrias, ONGs etc.

O foco dessa vaga é tocar toda a “BU” de exterior com os projetos de desenvolvimento. Dando mais tempo para mim criar a BU de Consultoria para o Brasil e depois voltar ao exterior como consultoria


Responsabilidades

·       Desenvolver em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente com foco em entregas de alto impacto.

·       Auxiliar tecnicamente em decisões de arquitetura de solução em projetos envolvendo Power Platform.

·       Fazer a ponte entre cliente e time técnico, garantindo clareza de escopo, alinhamento de expectativas e prazos.

·       Suporte na estruturação interna de processos e de conhecimento/documentação

·       Suporte na estruturação do perfil de MS Partner

·       Suporte na criação de novos produtos e serviços MS

Competências Comportamentais

Sangue nos olhos!

Interesse

Atenção aos detalhes

Proatividade

Over delivery

Boa comunicação visual e escrita

Fome de aprender

Auto responsabilidade

Raciocínio Lógico

Competências Técnicas

1.     Experiência avançada em várias ferramentas da Microsoft Power Platform

a.     Power Apps

b.     Power Automate

c.     Power BI

d.     Power Pages

e.     Dataverse

f.      Copilot Studio

2.     Capacidade de leitura e escrita de documentação técnica (API, banco de dados, lógica de automação).

3.     Inglês Avançado – Extremamente importante, já que 90% dos nossos clientes são de fora

Competências Culturais

1.      Qualidade: Não aceitar a mediocridade e sempre buscar fazer as coisas de forma ótima e aprimorada.

2.     Foco: Foco nos resultados, foco no que tem que ser feito – Se não controlamos ou se não nos leva aos objetivos, não ligamos.

3.     Ser “adulto”: Falar o que tem que ser dito, fazer o que tem que ser feito. Agir por conta própria.

4.     Responsabilidade Extrema: Não culpar os outros ou o ambiente pelos acontecimentos


Importante

Tipo de Trabalho : Home Office (possíveis encontros semanais entre o time em Campinas SP)

Horário de trabalho – Flexível e full-time durante o período do contrato. Seguir os horários do cliente – porem necessário estar online quando a maioria do time estiver.

Modelo de Contrato: PJ

Início Esperado: Imediato

Oferecemos

1.      Compensação – OTE > Fixa mensal + Variável Trimestral

2.     Reembolso de até 2 certificações por ano – verificar regras internas

3.     Acesso a Cursos, Treinamentos e Eventos

A nocobi é uma empresa focada em automatização de processos dos nossos clientes através soluções utilizando ferramentas de Low e NoCode. Desde o nosso início, tivemos cerca de 70 clientes em mais de 20 países, e estamos longe de desacelerar!

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com forte experiência em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), habilidades avançadas em SQL, Python e Google Apps Script. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções de integração, automação e análise de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência nos processos de negócio.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados utilizando BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Dataflow e demais serviços GCP.

Desenvolver queries SQL complexas para modelagem, análise e otimização de grandes volumes de dados.

Criar e manter scripts em Python para automação de processos, integrações e transformações de dados.

Utilizar Google Apps Script para automatizar rotinas em Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Gmail) e integrar com APIs externas.

Garantir qualidade, governança e consistência dos dados em ambientes de produção e desenvolvimento.

Monitorar pipelines e propor melhorias de performance e custo em soluções baseadas em GCP.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de negócio, analistas e engenheiros de dados para entregar soluções ágeis e de impacto.

Documentar processos técnicos e promover boas práticas de DevOps, versionamento e CI/CD.

Qualificações Necessárias

Experiência comprovada em Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).

Proficiência em SQL para análise e modelagem de dados.

Experiência sólida em Python para automação, integração e manipulação de dados.

Conhecimento em Google Apps Script aplicado à automação de processos em Google Workspace.

Familiaridade com Git, versionamento e práticas de DevOps.

Experiência em projetos de data warehousing, analytics ou BI.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Certificações GCP (Data Engineer, Cloud Engineer ou equivalentes).

Experiência com API integrations (REST, GraphQL).

Conhecimentos em machine learning pipelines ou MLOps.

Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Competências Comportamentais

Capacidade analítica e foco em resolução de problemas.

Comunicação clara e eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

Autonomia, organização e postura colaborativa.

VAGA REMOTA

title: Remote Content Writer - 45427
description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for a Content Writer to craft high-quality business and strategy questions, case studies, and structured content across diverse management domains. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical skills, excellent written English, and an MBA/business background who enjoys turning complex ideas into clear, engaging content


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop business/strategy questions in finance, public policy, e-commerce, sports analytics, etc.
  • Create case studies and real-world scenarios for MBA-level learners.
  • Organize content using structured formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • Ensure clarity, accuracy, and professionalism in all outputs.
  • Collaborate with experts to align content with real-world applications.


What We’re Looking For:

  • MBA or bachelor’s from a Tier-1/2 institute in business, economics, commerce, or management.
  • 1–5 years’ experience in content, consulting, research, or analysis.
  • Strong logical/analytical thinking and excellent written English.
  • Familiarity with structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • Bonus: prior experience in case study writing or academic/business content.


Why Join Us:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Flexible, remote-first environment.
  • Competitive pay with potential contract extensions.
  • Freelance perks: exposure to advanced AI, flexible hours, global collaboration.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.

title: Technical Sales Specialist - Brazil
description:
Do you want to join a fast-growing life sciences company with innovative solutions that are changing the landscape of genomics research?


Are you ready to build relationships with industry leaders while accelerating revenue growth in cutting-edge genomic and automation technologies?


As a Technical Sales Specialist , you will leverage your technical expertise and sales acumen to develop new opportunities, engage key opinion leaders, and close sales in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will play a pivotal role in advancing life sciences research and enabling affordable healthcare solutions for all.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING


Sales Growth and Strategy:

  • Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed revenue targets in your territory.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new opportunities for MGI’s products and solutions.


Customer Engagement and Support:

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, customers, and industry stakeholders in academic, government, and private sectors.
  • Provide pre-sales consultation and post-sales support, ensuring customers achieve optimal results with MGI products.


Technical Expertise and Education:

  • Deliver technical presentations, seminars, and workshops to educate customers on product capabilities and applications.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists, product managers, and R&D to provide comprehensive technical and promotional support.


Market Intelligence:

  • Gather and analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform product development and sales strategies.
  • Contribute to marketing efforts through trade shows, vendor events, and other promotional activities.


Reporting and Administration:

  • Maintain accurate CRM records (e.g., Salesforce), prepare sales forecasts, and provide regular activity reports.
  • Monitor sales metrics to evaluate performance and adjust strategies as needed.


ABOUT YOU

  • You thrive in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment where collaboration and innovation drive success.
  • Strong communicator with excellent presentation skills, able to engage both small and large audiences.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Passionate about advancing genomics and automation technologies to transform healthcare.


WHERE YOU WILL WORK


Brazil (São Paulo) :

  • Field-based role , eligible for remote work based in Brazil
  • Preferred location : São Paulo
  • Up to 50% travel across the territory to engage with customers and stakeholders, demonstrate and sell NGS instruments, attend regional events, and support market initiatives.


WHAT YOU WILL BRING US


Technical Expertise:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of NGS, DNA sequencing, RT-PCR, and molecular biology applications.
  • Hands-on experience with library preparation, lab automation, and system integration for sequencing workflows.


Sales Experience:

  • 5+ years of successful sales experience in life sciences, genomics, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales goals and develop long-term customer relationships.


Tech-Savvy Skills:

  • Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and MS Office Suite.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related field required; Master’s or advanced degree preferred.


Language:

  • English - advanced level
  • Spanish - intermediate/advanced knowledge desired



WHAT YOUR EDUCATION LOOKS LIKE

  • Master’s or Advanced Degree in life sciences or related fields preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree with significant technical and sales experience will also be considered.


HOW WE WILL REWARD YOU:

  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • Fitness allowance to support your wellness goals
  • Meal stipend to cover daily meal expenses
  • Dental Plan


ABOUT US

MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering high-quality genetic sequencers and advancing life sciences research. We’re dedicated to creating affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding regional operations across the Americas.


Ready to make an impact in life sciences and healthcare? Join us on this exciting journey toward affordable and effective solutions for all!

title: "Analista de Dados ETL/ODI Sr #974395"
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente do segmento de Moda/Vestuário.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Atuar em análises junto às áreas demandantes para compreender processos e fluxos de dados.

Participar da definição de soluções técnicas de integração.

Desenhar modelos de dados e arquiteturas de carga.

Desenvolver processos de ETL utilizando Java, Glue, Python, Terraform, Lambda, Kafka e ODI .


O que você precisa ter:

Sólida experiência na construção de processos de carga para Data Lake e Data Warehouse Teradata (camadas Stage, Relacional, Dimensional, View).

Forte conhecimento em Java e ODI .

Domínio em SQL .

Perfil analítico, com visão de ponta a ponta do fluxo de dados.

Experiência em AWS, Glue, Python, JavaScript, Lambda e Terraform para extração e carga no Datalake (landzone, raw).

Diferenciais: Pub/Sub, Power BI, Modelagem de Dados e Teradata .

Capacidade analítica e visão do todo.

Boa comunicação e interação com diferentes áreas.

Organização e atenção a detalhes em ambientes complexos de dados.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Atuação Remota.


Modelo de Contrato

Contratação CLT + benefícios

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 6+ years of DevOps and AWS experience to work with other team members on maintaining and executing organizational policies and procedures for change management, configuration management, release and deployment management, service monitoring, support, and problem management of the client's solutions for internal and customer environments.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2,000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, which reduces operating costs, saves time, and increases profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their infrastructure requirements, design solutions with cost mitigation in mind that meet their needs, and implement transparently and efficiently
  • Manage and optimize AWS environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices via tools such as Terraform
  • Own the design, development, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines - ensure rapid yet reliable code deployments
  • Integrate security practices into the infrastructure development lifecycle, including network security, identity management, and data protection
  • Ensure the achievement of SLOs via the implementation of effective SLIs to monitor systems and aid in issue diagnosis
  • Expand documentation and provide training to ensure clarity and proficient management by others, reducing future onboarding time
  • Monitor and optimize cloud spending
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest cloud computing and DevOps trends and best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 6+ years of experience in architecting, deploying, and managing complex enterprise-grade software solutions using AWS across various delivery modalities - mobile applications, web applications, APIs, web services, and UI frameworks
  • Extensive experience with CI/CD pipeline optimization via IaC platforms, must be highly knowledgeable of Terraform
  • Solid experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), version control systems (Git), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, and more)
  • Proven site reliability experience achieving SLOs through the definition and implementation of effective SLIs
  • Experience with operational database management in AWS (Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL)
  • Deep understanding of modern security best practices and a proven track record of implementing secure solutions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A strong aptitude for tackling complex challenges with right-size solutions that mitigate costs while assuring exceptional end-user experiences
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in environments that are constantly evolving and occasionally ambiguous


Desired Experience (not required)

  • University degree in Business, MIS, or Engineering
  • Familiar with New Relic, Loggly, and CloudWatch
  • Skilled in shell scripting (e.g., Bash, Python, and PowerShell)


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment, while building software. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Atendimento ao cliente
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A Le But é uma assessoria estratégica de marketing e branding especializada em clínicas e consultórios que desejam elevar sua percepção de valor, atrair pacientes com desejo e vender com consistência. Atuamos no ponto onde posicionamento, experiência e conversão se encontram, criando marcas memoráveis, jornadas encantadoras e estratégias que geram resultados reais.

Na prática, isso significa transformar a forma como médicos, dentistas, biomédicas e outros profissionais da saúde se comunicam com o mercado, através de um marketing que vende, encanta e posiciona com autoridade. Somos especialistas em construir marcas desejadas e clínicas de alto padrão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente.



Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um profissional para Atendimento ao Cliente para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve tarefas diárias como responder clientes no whatsapp, colher demandas, resolver problemas, garantir a satisfação do cliente e fazer a programação de conteúdos. A posição é de um cargo remoto.


Qualificações

  • Suporte ao Cliente e Satisfação do Cliente: É necessário ter habilidades em suporte ao cliente e garantir uma alta satisfação do cliente.


  • Experiência do Cliente: Capacidade de proporcionar uma experiência positiva e eficiente para os clientes.
  • Além das habilidades acima, é desejável ter boa comunicação, paciência e habilidades em resolução de problemas.

title: PHP Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for PHP Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Able to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as collaborate with a diverse team.

- Accountable for resolution of the most technically challenging issues facing the organization.

- Write code with increasing quality and maintainability.

- Guide the architecture of large features which impact all parts of the company, identifying issues and raising concerns/blockers for mitigation.

- Research and introduce new technology to improve the applications and/or the development pipeline.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience working with PHP with strong Front-End skills.

- Workflow Management, design and implementation in all its stages.

- Collaboration with the development team in the achievement of technical challenges, code upgrades, working closely with architects, developers, business analysts, testers and product owners.

- Contribution to the preparation of technical documentation.

- Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and other frameworks such as, among others, Angular and React.

- Experience with frameworks such as Zend, Laravel, Symphony is desirable.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Machine Learning Sênior
description:
Requisitos: Experiência sólida com engenharia de software aplicada a dados e machine learning.

Proficiência em Python e frameworks como PySpark, Pandas, Scikit-learn ou similares.

Experiência com ferramentas e serviços AWS, como S3, Lambda, Step Functions, Glue, Athena, SageMaker ou ECS. Conhecimento em MLOps e CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos.

Experiência com orquestração de workflows.

Capacidade de escrever código limpo, modular e testável.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation).

Participação em projetos de ML em produção com foco em confiabilidade e rastreabilidade.


Responsabilidades principais:

Projetar e implementar pipelines de validação de dados e avaliação de modelos em ambiente cloud (AWS).

Integrar dados e métricas de avaliação em um fluxo automatizado e auditável.

Modularizar o pipeline para facilitar reuso, testes e manutenção.

Trabalhar em colaboração com times de Data Science, Engenharia de Dados e Produto.

Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, logging, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Propor melhorias contínuas na arquitetura de dados e nos processos de validação.


Modelo de atuação: Remoto

title: Senior Mobile Application Developer
description:
Job Location: San Francisco, CA, US (Remote)

Job Title: Senior Mobile Developer

Job Type: Full-Time


About the Role


We’re a rapidly scaling healthtech platform connecting healthcare facilities with on-the-ground professionals ready to close urgent staffing gaps. Our app helps nurses access better-paying, flexible shifts while enabling facilities to deliver exceptional patient care. As a Senior Mobile Developer, you’ll build technology that makes a real-world impact—at scale. We develop solutions that quite literally help save lives, and we take that mission seriously.

Responsibilities
  • Lead end-to-end development of our React Native mobile applications for iOS and Android
  • Build fast, reliable, and scalable features with our modern tech stack (React Native, Node.js, Redis)
  • Partner with cross-functional teams—from backend engineers to product managers—focused on user outcomes
  • Design and deliver robust architecture that prioritizes performance and maintainability
  • Contribute to a strong team culture through mentorship, pairing, and open feedback
Requirements
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Excellent English communication skills, spoken and written
  • Proven track record delivering production-grade mobile apps with React Native
  • Comfortable working across time zones and following remote-first best practices
Nice to Haves
  • Previous experience with U.S.-based startups or technology companies
  • Background in healthtech or other mission-driven B2B platforms
Benefits
  • Competitive USD compensation
  • Collaborate with Silicon Valley-level teams from your own timezone
  • Long-term projects with meaningful real-world impact
  • Work alongside top-tier global talent and leadership
  • Plenty of room to grow, innovate, and take ownership of your work

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Join Manukora, the #1 D2C Manuka Business in the USA.

Are you someone who thrives on taking charge, driving results, and staying steps ahead? Do you excel in fast-paced settings and possess an intuitive ability to understand and fulfill the needs of a dynamic team? If this resonates with you, an exciting opportunity awaits!


We’re looking for a creative, data-savvy, and proactive Video Editor to craft high-performing social media content for our fast-growing brand. This role is fully remote, with preference for some overlap with PST working hours. You’ll be at the heart of Manukora’s storytelling engine — transforming briefs into thumb-stopping, results-driven content for multiple social platforms.


This is a high-trust, high-autonomy position suited for someone who’s self-directed, obsessed with craft, and energized by creative momentum.


What You’ll Do

  • Create compelling, high-performance social media ads that align with creative briefs and drive measurable results
  • Design dynamic motion graphics, text animations, and visual effects that enhance storytelling and brand messaging
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, creative leads, and editors to optimize video and graphics content tailored for social platforms
  • Apply performance insights and creative feedback to continually refine and elevate ad effectiveness
  • Take creative ownership of projects while remaining highly receptive to feedback and iteration
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met
  • Maintain organized and efficient Adobe project files


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience creating engaging digital content for social media platforms
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills with a strong foundation in storytelling and pacing
  • Intermediate+ Adobe After Effects proficiency (motion graphics, kinetic typography, and visual effects)
  • Deep understanding of social media optimization and platform-specific best practices
  • Excellent English communication skills (written & verbal) for effective collaboration with international teams
  • Quick learner who thrives on feedback, adapts rapidly to new challenges, and takes ownership of creative work
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment


Bonus Points For

  • Experience with AI-powered creative tools (Midjourney, RunwayML, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Digital advertising agency or performance marketing experience
  • Proven track record optimizing video content for social media algorithms
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud Libraries and collaborative workflows
  • Background in data-driven creative optimization


Details

  • Role Type: Full-time, Remote
  • Location: Open — at least partial overlap with PST preferred
  • Start Date: ASAP


How to Apply

Send us an email at with:

  • A few lines about what excites you about this role
  • Your resume
  • A link to your portfolio showcasing your best work


Email Only: Please note, we’re all about direct connections. Make sure to send your application via email.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Location:  Fully remote

Employment type:  Part-time


About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is the worlds first AI Super App designed to help anyone earn, learn, and grow in the AI era. We are building a global, fully remote team to shape the future of financial technology. Our mission is to make powerful AI-driven financial and business tools accessible to everyone from individuals starting side hustles to enterprises scaling globally.


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and driven MLOps Engineer to design, automate, and optimize our machine learning infrastructure. In this role, you will play a crucial part in bridging the gap between data science and operations by streamlining our AI/ML workflows from experimentation to production.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, and developers to ensure our models are secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient. Your work will directly impact thousands of users worldwide by enabling real-time, AI-powered financial insights and business solutions.

If you are passionate about deploying cutting-edge ML technologies and want to be part of a mission-driven fintech startup, wed love to hear from you!


What You'll Do:
  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end machine learning infrastructure ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance.
  • Automate ML pipelines with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD frameworks.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to streamline model deployment.
  • Monitor and optimize models in production with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for efficiency and cost.
  • Ensure compliance and security protocols for sensitive financial data.
  • Provide support and maintenance to ensure the reliability of ML applications.


What You'll Bring:
  • Proven experience as an MLOps Engineer or similar role (fintech or AI startup experience is a plus).
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); familiarity with Java or Scala is a plus.
  • Experience with ML frameworks and pipeline orchestration (MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools.
  • Strong understanding of ML algorithms and their real-world applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote, cross-timezone team environment.
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).


Why Youll Love Working at Bizmoni:
  • Be part of a mission-driven company building the future of AI-powered FinTech.
  • Fully remote role with a global, diverse team.
  • Equity-based compensation with the potential for future full-time opportunities.
  • Culture of innovation, collaboration, and ownership.|


Before Applying, Ask Yourself:
  • Are you open to equity-based compensation?
  • Are you able to dedicate 16 hours weekly to our project?


If your answers are YES , then we are happy to meet you!


Recruitment Process:

  • Interview with Data Science Department Manager & TA Partner.
  • Offer (based on final positive feedback).


Please submit your your English CV .


Only shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview. Thank you.
company: Bizmoni - The Next Gen AI Super APP

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and driven MLOps Engineer to design, automate, and optimize our machine learning infrastructure. In this role, you will play a crucial part in bridging the gap between data science and operations by streamlining our AI/ML workflows from experimentation to production.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, and developers to ensure our models are secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient. Your work will directly impact thousands of users worldwide by enabling real-time, AI-powered financial insights and business solutions.

If you are passionate about deploying cutting-edge ML technologies and want to be part of a mission-driven fintech startup, wed love to hear from you!


What You'll Do:
  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end machine learning infrastructure ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance.
  • Automate ML pipelines with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD frameworks.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to streamline model deployment.
  • Monitor and optimize models in production with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for efficiency and cost.
  • Ensure compliance and security protocols for sensitive financial data.
  • Provide support and maintenance to ensure the reliability of ML applications.

  • Solid knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools.
  • Strong understanding of ML algorithms and their real-world applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote, cross-timezone team environment.
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).


Why Youll Love Working at Bizmoni:

  • Equity-based compensation with the potential for future full-time opportunities.

title: English Teacher
description:
Descrição da Empresa Empresa com cerca de 100 alunos, níveis básico, intermediário e avançado.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Professor de Inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe em um formato de contrato. Este papel é focado em oferecer aulas de inglês online, planejando e preparando lições eficazes que atendam às necessidades dos alunos. As responsabilidades diárias incluem desenvolver materiais didáticos, avaliar o progresso dos estudantes e fornecer feedback construtivo. Este é um cargo remoto, permitindo que você trabalhe de qualquer lugar.

Qualificações

  • Ensino de Inglês: Necessário possuir experiência em ensino de inglês, com conhecimento das melhores práticas pedagógicas.
  • Planejamento de Aulas: Habilidades em planejar e organizar, de forma online, lições de forma eficaz e criativa para maximizar o aprendizado dos alunos.
  • Educação e Ensino: Formação e experiência em educação e ensino são essenciais para garantir a qualidade das aulas ministradas.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito, são essenciais para garantir a interação produtiva entre os alunos.
  • Além das habilidades acima, será considerado um diferencial a fluência em outros idiomas e a capacidade de utilizar plataformas digitais de ensino.

title: Business Director
description:
Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary
  • Private health insurance and paid vacation benefits
  • Senior leadership role with high visibility and direct impact across Latin America
  • Opportunity to represent an established global iGaming company at events, exhibitions, and partner meetings


Who Will You Work For?

A leading international iGaming provider with a strong presence across multiple regions, now expanding its commercial leadership in Latin America. The company is committed to innovation, strategic growth, and building long-term partnerships in the online gaming space.

With a portfolio that includes top-performing slot game products, the company is trusted by partners worldwide for delivering engaging, high-quality solutions. As part of its LatAm expansion, we’re seeking a Business Director / Manager in Brazil to drive strategic partnerships, lead the team, and grow the company’s influence in the region.


Why This Role?

As the Business Director / Manager, you’ll be the driving force behind expanding and strengthening B2B partnerships across Brazil and Latin America. You will lead negotiations, shape go-to-market strategies, and ensure seamless execution of commercial projects.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven leader with an established network in the iGaming industry, strong knowledge of the Brazilian and LatAm markets, and the ambition to grow business relationships in a highly competitive space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Expand and negotiate B2B iGaming partnerships across Brazil and Latin America
  • Identify potential partners and adjust strategies based on market changes and opportunities
  • Plan and execute integrated online and offline marketing campaigns
  • Analyze market trends, competitors, and player behaviors to provide actionable insights
  • Promote slot game products effectively to partners, designing tailored solutions when needed
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth project execution and delivery
  • Stay current with Latin American market dynamics and gaming regulations
  • Represent the company at industry exhibitions and events to build brand influence
  • Lead and motivate a regional team to enhance efficiency and performance


Requirements:

  • Must be based in Brazil (Brazilian nationality preferred)
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a plus)
  • Established network/resources in the B2B iGaming industry within Latin America
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience at a large B2B iGaming company in the region
  • Proven experience in partnership expansion, commercial negotiations, and market strategy
  • Strong communication, coordination, and cross-cultural skills
  • Willingness to travel occasionally across the region
  • Leadership and management experience is an advantage


Benefits:

  • High-impact, senior-level role with ownership of LatAm growth strategy
  • Exposure to international markets and opportunities to represent the brand globally
  • Collaborative and ambitious company culture focused on long-term growth


Ready to take on a leadership role in shaping the future of iGaming partnerships across Latin America? Apply now and be part of a company driving innovation and growth in the region.

title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!


Job Description:

  • Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
  • Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
  • Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
  • Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
  • Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
  • Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
  • Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
  • Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
  • Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.


Requirements:

  • Integration Procedure
  • Data Raptor
  • Omniscript
  • FlexCard
  • Calculation Matrices
  • Validation Rule
  • Flow
  • Profile
  • Lightning Page
  • Role
  • Apex
  • LWC


Skill Set:

  • Omni Studio Proficiency: Strong experience with Omni Studio tools, including OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards.
  • Salesforce Development: Proficiency in Apex programming, Visualforce pages, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Declarative Tools: Expertise in using Salesforce's declarative tools for customization.
  • Integration Skills: Experience with Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Testing: Ability to write comprehensive test cases and perform various testing methods.
  • Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Deployment: Experience with deployment methodologies and tools like Salesforce DX.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Agile Methodology: Understanding of Agile development practices.
  • Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying current with Salesforce features and updates.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Calypso Front Office Business Analyst
description:
Why Join Qaracter


Qaracter is an international consulting firm specialized in the financial and banking sector. We partner with leading institutions to drive transformation projects across compliance, technology, operations, and risk management.


With a global mindset and strong expertise in financial services, we help our clients face complex challenges and design innovative solutions.


What powers it all? Our people — ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.



What You’ll Do

  • Work with trade capture, pricing, simulation reports, sensitivities
  • Support front office modules including P&L, risk, compliance, and market data
  • Contribute to curve and product definitions, trade blotters, and limit setups
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders and deliver under tight deadlines



What You Bring

  • 5+ years in finance industry projects, ideally in capital markets
  • Hands-on Calypso experience across front office functions
  • Strong planning, communication, and analytical skills
  • Degree in Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Proficiency in Java, SQL, and scripting


Location

LATAM (Remote).



Your Benefits at Qaracter

  • Opportunity to work on international financial projects.
  • Flexibility: remote, hybrid, or in-office options depending on the client.
  • Recognition and referral programs.
  • Ongoing learning and training opportunities with reimbursement options.
  • Well-being program and team events.
  • Competitive compensation and top-tier equipment provision.



At QARACTER Group, we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities and non-discrimination in all our processes, promoting an inclusive and diverse work environment. All applications are welcome regardless of sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, age, disability, or any other personal or social condition, in line with our Plan de Igualdad and our commitment to equity.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Project Manager at Mosaic Puzzles. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing the company's project portfolio, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring timely and successful project delivery. They will also be responsible for developing project plans, monitoring progress, and addressing any issues that arise.


Role Responsibilities

  • Run and oversee project management and program management functions across the entire company
  • Manage business operations internal to the organization
  • Manage trade shows and holiday market events (staffing, logistics, planning)
  • Travel to the United States as needed for trade shows and events
  • Run annual and quarterly planning for the company
  • Set the pace and ensure all stakeholders are accountable to timelines
  • Determine departmental KPIs for annual and quarterly goal setting


Qualifications

  • Project Management, Program Management, and Team Leadership skills
  • Strategic Planning and Decision-Making abilities
  • Excellent Communication and Interpersonal skills
  • Cost benefit analysis skills
  • Analytical skills
  • Design skills a plus
  • Risk Management and Problem-Solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or related field
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP) is a plus
  • 7-15 years of project management experience


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Agente de Viagens com Português Avançado + Amadeus
description:
Sobre a Boostomer


A Boostomer é uma Agência de Experiência do Cliente com sede em Barcelona, que oferece serviços de consultoria e terceirização para empresas emergentes e em expansão.


Descrição

Um dos nossos clientes é uma empresa especializada em serviços de atendimento ao cliente para agências de viagens, operando na Espanha e em Portugal. Nossa equipe atua no suporte a viajantes corporativos fora do horário comercial, garantindo um atendimento de alta qualidade em momentos críticos.


O que estamos buscando?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Agente de Viagens com experiência em reservas e suporte a clientes corporativos, com disponibilidade para atuar em turnos noturnos e nos fins de semana. Se você é organizado(a), autônomo(a) e com habilidades em resolução de problemas, queremos te conhecer!


Você é a pessoa ideal se:

✅ Fala português em nível avançado (não consideramos nível intermediário).

✅ Tem experiência avançada comprovada com o sistema Amadeus.

✅ É autônomo(a), resolutivo(a) e capaz de lidar com emergências.

✅ Tem experiência em gestão de reservas, alterações e suporte a viajantes corporativos.


Responsabilidades:

Oferecer suporte a viajantes corporativos em situações de emergência.

Gerenciar reservas e alterações usando sistemas como Amadeus.

Resolver incidentes de forma eficiente, garantindo uma experiência fluida ao cliente.


⏰ Horário e disponibilidade:

Todos os turnos serão informados com pelo menos 1 mês de antecedência. Horários abaixo expressos em hora da Argentina.

  • De segunda a sexta-feira: das 02h às 04h (madrugada)
  • Fins de semana: 10 horas divididas entre sábado e domingo, ou concentradas em um único dia. Faixa de horário: das 03h às 19h.

Exemplo 1 – dividido: sábado das 14h às 19h e domingo das 14h às 19h

Exemplo 2 – concentrado em 1 dia: das 09h às 19h ou das 03h às 13h

Excepcionalmente, pode haver necessidade de um turno vespertino das 13h às 19h.

Observação: a partir de março/abril, haverá mudança de horário na Espanha (adiantamento de 1 hora).


Benefícios:

  • Pagamento por hora em USD, conforme sua experiência e habilidades
  • Participação em um projeto com grande projeção e crescimento
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo
  • Treinamento 100% pago
  • Modalidade 100% remota


Previsão de início: Julho de 2025


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Computador: processador Core i5 (7ª geração ou superior), ou equivalente, com no mínimo 8 GB de RAM
  • Armazenamento: mínimo de 256 GB SSD ou 500 GB HDD
  • Internet: velocidade mínima de 25 Mbps (upload e download)
  • Sistema operacional: Windows original
  • Áudio: fones de ouvido com cancelamento de ruído
  • Vídeo: notebook/PC com webcam ou câmera de boa qualidade

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The company and our mission:


Zartis is a digital solutions provider working across technology strategy, software engineering and product development.


We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. Our engineering hubs in EMEA and LATAM are full of talented professionals delivering business success and digital improvement across application development, software architecture, CI/CD, business intelligence, QA automation, and new technology integrations.


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on a project in the modern healthcare industry.


The project:


You will be joining the Booking team, contributing to a platform that simplifies healthcare appointment scheduling for millions of patients and providers. In this role, you’ll help shape how key information - such as insurance details - is collected and validated, ensuring a seamless booking journey.


Your work will center on evolving data models, improving system performance, and strengthening the reliability of a high-volume booking system. By collaborating with experienced engineers, you’ll extend and optimize microservices in the booking domain, driving scalability, cost efficiency, and stability. This is an opportunity to apply deep technical expertise while making a meaningful impact in a distributed, innovation-driven environment.


What you will do:


- Building large-scale APIs and microservices, creating frictionless data flows that empower both patients and providers to access care and information in real time.

- Mentoring fellow engineers, supercharging team throughput through robust coding standards, automated workflows, and a culture of continuous improvement.

- Spearheading bold innovation, whether it’s adopting generative AI, exploring emerging data sources, or pioneering architectural strategies that keep the platform ahead in healthcare tech.

- Decomposing complex product challenges to drive sound design decisions.

- Collaborating with an agile team of engineers, product managers, and designers.

- Working with cutting-edge GenAI tools and technology.


What you will bring:


- Inspiration to positively impact the healthcare experience of millions of patients and providers.

- A product-driven mindset with relentless focus on user needs.

- Strong autonomy, accountability, and comfort in a remote-first environment.

- Passion for engineering fundamentals and promoting best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability.

- Commitment to fostering diverse and inclusive teams and culture.

- Entrepreneurial spirit with strong ownership, thriving in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.

- Ability to craft database schemas, implement REST APIs, and design event-driven queue and stream processing systems, ideally with C#, .NET Core, and AWS.

- A history of solid and well-rounded system design skills.

- Leadership by example in testing, deployment, and observability practices.

- Excellent communication skills: able to dive into technical detail with engineers while presenting clear solutions to non-technical audiences.

- Comfort working with distributed teams.

- Experience integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, drive innovation, and maximize productivity.


What we offer:


- 100% Remote Work.

- WFH allowance: Monthly

- Excellent communication skills: able to dive into technical detail with engineers while presenting clear solutions to non-technical audiences.

- Comfort working with distributed teams.

- Experience integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, drive innovation, and maximize productivity.

- 100% Remote Work.

- WFH allowance: Monthly

title: Arquiteto de Software
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Arquiteto Backend NodeJs/Java para integrar nosso time de tecnologia e atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance.

Se você gosta de desafios, tem espírito colaborativo e deseja trabalhar em um ambiente inovador, essa vaga é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs em Node.js e Java (Quarkus e Spring) .

Implementar e integrar soluções de mensageria com RabbitMQ .

Trabalhar com MongoDB em cenários de alto volume de dados.

Construir, implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes e Docker .

Colaborar com o time na definição de arquiteturas e boas práticas.

Apoiar na evolução contínua dos sistemas e na resolução de incidentes.


Requisitos e qualificações:

✅ Requisitos Fundamentais

  • Node.js
  • Java (Quarkus e Spring)
  • RabbitMQ
  • MongoDB
  • Kubernetes
  • Docker


Conhecimentos Desejáveis

  • Redis (noção conceitual, disposição para aprender rapidamente)
  • GoLang (noção conceitual, disposição para aprender rapidamente)
  • Argo (desejável)
  • PostgreSQL (desejável)


O que valorizamos

  • Proatividade, colaboração e boa comunicação.
  • Vontade de aprender novas tecnologias.
  • Comprometimento com qualidade de código, boas práticas e segurança.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
We are hiring a Senior HR Recruiter (Remote | Full-Time)

Help shape the future of our team by attracting and hiring top talent for a fast-growing international company.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Senior HR Recruiter who thrives in dynamic environments and has a proven track record of building strong teams. In this role, you will manage end-to-end recruitment processes, collaborate closely with leadership, and implement strategies to attract high-performing professionals across different functions.


About the Role

You will be responsible for leading recruitment efforts for diverse roles, from marketing to operations, ensuring an excellent candidate experience and alignment with business needs. This position requires strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to identify and engage top talent globally.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing and screening to offers and onboarding
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and design tailored recruitment strategies
  • Develop and maintain a strong talent pipeline through proactive sourcing and networking
  • Conduct competency-based interviews and assessments to identify best-fit candidates
  • Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring process
  • Track recruitment metrics and provide regular reports and insights to leadership
  • Stay updated on recruitment trends and best practices in global talent acquisition


Requirements

  • Proven experience as an HR Recruiter, with at least 3–5 years in senior or lead recruitment roles
  • Strong understanding of sourcing techniques, recruitment tools, and employer branding strategies
  • Experience recruiting across different functions (marketing, operations, creative, etc.)
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Fluency in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week with flexibility


Why Join Us

  • Fully remote role with flexible scheduling
  • Opportunity to shape the growth of an international company
  • Career development and advancement opportunities
  • Collaborative and people-focused work environment
